name: Haruka Ruha
source:
Ruha is the queen of the Falkensleben Kingdom ever since her parents died. She is a popular queen and a lot of people like her due to the fact that she’s down-to-earth. She does have trouble getting up in the morning and doesn’t usually get up until Hayato steals her favourite teddy bear. She’s childhood friends with model Hiromi. She’s also got a cat allergy.

[Taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/12/18/shinsei-ni-shite-okasubekarazu-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
